court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before Anita Sumanth and Sunder Mohan, JJ.)
appellants: Jaseena P.K. … Petitioner/Wife of the Detenu;
respondents: Secretary to Government, Co-operation Food and Consumer Production Department and Others
advocates: Mr. S. Surya for Mr. W. Camyles Gandhi., for the Petitioner;
Mr. R. Muniyapparaj Additional Public Prosecutor assisted by Mr.M.Sylvester John, for the Respondents.
judgment_text:
Prayer : Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying to issue a writ of habeas corpus to call for the entire records, relating to the petitioner's husband detention under EC Act, 1980 (Central Act 7 of 1980) vide detention order, 22.01.2026 on the file of the second respondent herein made in proceedings in C.No.01/PBMMSEC.Act/IS/2026, quash the same as illegal and consequently direct the respondents herein to produce the petitioner's husband namely M.Abi @ Habeeb Rahuman, S/o. Mohamed Ismail, aged 48 years, before this Court and set the petitioner's husband at liberty from detention, now the petitioner's husband detained at Central Prison, Coimbatore.

ORDER

Anita Sumanth, J.:— Mr Muniyapparaj, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, produces a copy of order dated 17-2-2026 issued by the Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection (E1) Department in G.O.(Rt) No. 41 revoking order dated 10-2-2026 passed under Section 10 of the Prevention of Black Marketing and Maintenance of Supplies of Essential Commodities Act, 1980 (Central Act 7 of 1980).

2. In light of the same, nothing survives in this petition and recording the aforesaid, this habeas corpus petition is closed. No costs.
